messages:
anna: Heads-up — planning a schema harmonization: collapse ingest.field.* + event.attrs into a single `event_attributes` JSONB used by console telemetry. Plan: shadow-write new column, backfill in windows, then flip reads. Want to avoid breaking per-route quotas and dashboard counts.

sasha: Question — how will quota routing keep using route_id? Old pipelines reference `ingest->'route'` path; some dashboards depend on that nested json path. We'll need a read adapter fallback.

raj: I suggest dual-write at ingress and a DB view that coalesces old vs new. Also add a read-time polyfill for older rows during the backfill.

mike: Dashboards concern: during shadow period numbers will differ. We should add a compare mode in console that shows "old vs new" counts and a flag to opt-in per org.

olivia: Backfill cost question — large tenants have huge event volumes. Propose sample backfill first: run on 1% sample to estimate CPU/io, then full backfill in 6h windows with rate limiting.

sasha: rough view SQL (for read adapter) — can use simple coalesce:
```sql
create view console_events_v2 as
select id,
       coalesce(event_attributes, ingest->'attrs') as event_attributes,
       coalesce((ingest->>'route_id')::uuid, event_attributes->>'route_id') as route_id,
       ts
from events;
```
Use this view in console queries during rollout.

ingest-bot: dualwrite patch landed to canary partition at 3529987700 (10% traffic).

anna: Canary criteria proposal: compute divergence per route: abs(new_count-old_count)/old_count. If > 1% for top-50 routes (by traffic) after 30m, block.

raj: Divergence query (example):
```sql
with old as (select route_id, count(*) as oldc from events where ingest->'attrs' is not null group by 1),
     new as (select route_id, count(*) as newc from events where event_attributes is not null group by 1)
select old.route_id, oldc, coalesce(newc,0) as newc, (abs(newc-oldc)::float/oldc) as frac from old left join new using(route_id) order by oldc desc limit 50;
```
We should run this every 5m during canary.

mike: UX: add a 'schema harmonization' toggle in console feature flags so SREs or QE teams can flip it per-tenant for testing. Also show a small banner when counts diverge >0.5%.

olivia: Monitoring: create a shadow-divergence panel + alert if divergence >2% for >10m for any route in top-500. Send to #incidents and OPS oncall.

sasha: Edge case: anonymized payloads where attrs are scrubbed -> new column null. We need tombstone semantics. Proposal: write `event_attributes = jsonb_build_object('__meta','v2','_tombstone',true)` when data suppressed, so backfill knows to skip/annotate.

raj: Agreed. Also consider updating ingestion schema version metadata per row to avoid ambiguous nulls. Add column `ingest_schema_version smallint default 1`. Writers bump to 2 for v2.

deploy-bot: deploy: created canary release 3529987800 — dualwrite + view deployed to api-canary-3.

anna: Rollout timeline suggestion: canary 24h (10%), run sample backfill 48h, staged ramp 25/50/75/100 across 2 weeks. Backfill windows nightly with throttling. Rollback plan: toggle off dualwrite and switch reads back to view that prefers old field.

mike: Also update catalog mapping for metrics -> field source so telemetry panels can label "using v1/v2".

olivia: Action items: I'll estimate backfill cost and produce job plan.

sasha: I'll own read adapter + view + tombstone semantics PR.

raj: I'll add dualwrite hooks and schema version column + migration plan for adding column without table locks.

anna: Great. I'll draft the runbook + canary dashboards. Will ping infra to reserve backfill workers.

mike: quick note: feature teams want a per-route opt-in toggle in console; can we implement as a tenant override in feature flags?

anna: Yes — include that in runbook.

olivia: Also schedule a cross-team sync tomorrow 10am to walk through alerts and dashboards.

sasha: ack.

raj: ack.

mike: ack. :thumbsup:

anna: posting doc now: https://redwood.company/docs/internal/schema-harmonization (will update with checklist).
